profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Microsoft
profile.summary: I'm passionate about pushing the boundaries of augmented reality and creating seamless user experiences! When I think about what drew me to software engineering, it comes down to removing the barriers between people and technology. Whether that takes place in the form of AR experiments or the perfect UI, I hope to be part of the effort to create more inclusive and ubiquitous products!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing a new PCF control to integrate Microsoft's AI models for missed appointments through Dynamics 365 and TypeScript.
- Actively owning the Cloud for Healthcare Patient Portal by implementing new UI features and updating workflows to provide a seamless user experience.
- Driving compliance across all our offerings as accessibility lead through cross-team collaboration. 
- Utilized Bootstrap to contribute to the front-end development of Microsoft's Vaccine Management Solution to distribute COVID-19 vaccinations.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description: - Worked closely with WICS Marketing Committee to create Facebook Event graphics, flyers, and other designs.

company.name: Women in Information and Computer Science

positions.title: Mixed Reality Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Performed detailed research on the different features of Flutter and React
Native, with an emphasis on AR+Unity integration to determine the benefits of
re-platforming Microsoft's Remote Assist Mobile application.
- Created two fully fleshed-out prototypes of the app via Flutter and React
Native to showcase AR compatibility and numerous UI/technical solutions.
- Tracked various performance measures, including accessibility options,
developer velocity, and ease of AR integration to present a full argument to the
senior leadership team.

positions.title: Academic & Alumni Affairs Chair
positions.description:
- Leading the committee that deals with alumni relations and interaction between the student body and faculty. 
- Coordinating the Med (AR) App Jam, a 2-week long medical coding competition, with corporate sponsors and partners such as Apple and the UCI School of Medicine.
- Organizing workshops in conjunction with company representatives to educate students about Apple’s ARKit, the augmented reality platform used in the Med (AR) App Jam.
- Establishing a social and technical mentorship program for under-represented high school students in STEM.
- Creating an ICS-specific alumni database to bring relevant industry experiences to students.

company.name: Information and Computer Science Student Council

positions.title: Explore Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a data visualization platform that showcases real-time transactions and is used in numerous business applications such as product launches and downtime monitoring. 
- Utilized internal APIs to pull JSON data streams and filter relevant data.  
- Led a security review to evaluate internal/external threats and bring the service to production level; included the addition of alert monitoring for the production environment.

honors.title: ICS/BRAID Scholarship
honors.description:
- Full scholarship to the 2017 Grace Hopper Celebration of Women in Computing.
- Sponsored by Building, Recruiting, and Inclusion for Diversity (BRAID); required active involvement in supporting women in computing and excellent academic performance.
honors.issuer: Issued by Building, Recruiting, and Inclusion for Diversity (BRAID) · Jun 2017

honors.title: Dean's Honor List
honors.description: Students who reach a quarterly grade point average (GPA) of 3.5 or better in a minimum of 12 graded units are honored with a position on the Dean's Honor List.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of California, Irvine · Jan 2017

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Mission: To inspire young girls to pursue STEM fields to break the current male stereotype. In order to achieve this, we hosted a workshop for local young girls to attend and build simple devices, which will then be sent to non-profit organizations to empower them and let them know that they can make a difference.
- I helped run the workshop by guiding the Girl Scouts troop through building the Simon Say's kits with soldering irons, exposing them to real-world engineering concepts.
- We also took the troop on a tour of UCI's nuclear reactor underneath the Physics department, which helped create interest in the higher levels of science.

projects.title: Cardboard HoloLens
projects.description:
- Designing and building a functional and accessible version of the HoloLens out of cardboard.
- Producing quality viewing content for a standalone device; current version can view moving images with a smartphone attached.
- Software Used: Unity Game Engine, Adobe Photoshop

volunteerExperience.description:
- Mission: To inspire young girls to pursue STEM fields to break the current male stereotype. In order to achieve this, we hosted a workshop for local young girls to attend and build simple devices, which will then be sent to non-profit organizations to empower them and let them know that they can make a difference.
- I helped run the workshop by guiding the Girl Scouts troop through building the Simon Say's kits with soldering irons, exposing them to real-world engineering concepts.
- We also took the troop on a tour of UCI's nuclear reactor underneath the Physics department, which helped create interest in the higher levels of science.
